checks.title: Material left under the USB relief (localised, below the 2.0 mm rule)
checks.detail: Accepted locally because the port sits 3.31 mm deep on the back side; confirm by drop/insertion test.

checks.title: Body thickness (face film to rear floor)
checks.detail: with caps 15.05 mm. The rear floor sits 0.2 mm below the tallest back-side part, L2 (Sunlord ASWPA4035, 3.50 mm). Sub-12 mm needs every back-side part ≤ 1.95 mm (over today: L2 3.50, J2 3.31, J5 3.00, J4 3.00, J3 3.00, L3 2.00, L1 2.00, J1 2.00), which is a PCB change, and a cell no thicker than 6.50 mm: the 7.0 mm cell alone holds the body at ≥ 12.55 mm. Replacing only L2 and J2 gives 13.05 mm.

checks.title: Battery envelope fits the board window with swelling allowance
checks.detail: ≥10 % of cell thickness free in front of the cell

checks.title: Battery XY clearance to the board window
Cell choice (703450 class, ~1300 mAh) and protected pack with JST SH 3-pin lead
checks.detail: Order a protected cell with NTC, 3-pin to J3 (BAT+, NTC, GND).

checks.title: Enclosure joint: plain 1.0 mm lap, no detent modelled; the board has no mounting holes for screws
checks.detail: Print and drop-test the lap; add a detent or snap feature, perimeter clips or adhesive if it opens.

checks.title: LCD retained by adhesive on the pocket ledge (no rear support under the module)
checks.detail: Specify the adhesive frame; the 1.7 mm gap behind the module is the battery swelling allowance and must stay empty.
